name: new_empty
description: Representative ATen signature (representative, NOT exclusive): aten::new_empty(Tensor self, SymInt[] size, *, ScalarType? dtype=None, Layout? layout=None, Device? device=None, bool? pin_memory=None) -> Tensor. All supplied registered schemas, verbatim: default -> aten::new_empty(Tensor self, SymInt[] size, *, ScalarType? dtype=None, Layout? layout=None, Device? device=None, bool? pin_memory=None) -> Tensor ; out -> aten::new_empty.out(Tensor self, SymInt[] size, *, Tensor(a!) out) -> Tensor(a!). Semantics (new_empty is an allocation operator, not a compute operator): it returns a fresh, uninitialized buffer whose shape is the requested size while dtype and device default to the source tensor self, layout defaults to the source layout, and pin_memory defaults to False (pin_memory is not inherited from self); the source payload is never read, the source storage is never mutated, the result owns fresh storage (never aliases self), and the result carries no autograd history (requires_grad is False and grad_fn is None even when self tracks gradients). size accepts a tuple, a list, a torch.Size, or bool extents which are normalised to 1/0; empty and zero-extent shapes are valid (numel 0). Explicit dtype overrides the inherited dtype. An explicit device is honoured when it resolves to a device of a different type than the source; when the requested device has the source's device type the observed result device is the source tensor's device (an indexed request is honoured exactly, an un-indexed accelerator request resolves to the current device index). Layout defaults to the source layout and may be torch.strided or a non-block sparse layout (sparse_source propagates its layout; an explicit strided layout overrides a sparse source); block sparse layouts (bsr/bsc) and 1-D compressed sparse sizes are rejected, invalid extents (float components, nested tuples, negative values) and invalid self/dtype/layout arguments raise TypeError or RuntimeError. With deterministic algorithms and torch.utils.deterministic.fill_uninitialized_memory enabled, the fresh buffer is filled instead of left uninitialized (NaN for float, INT_MAX for int) and the payload becomes observable. The out overload aten::new_empty.out writes into and returns the caller supplied keyword-only out buffer (res_out is buf), resizing it when its shape differs and preserving the buffer's own dtype, strides, storage offset and parent storage; that overload mutates and returns an alias of out and is not expressed by this definition. The original Gems pytest owns the full contract: overloads, keyword arguments, returns, error behavior, and aliasing/mutation semantics; this representative signature is a single ABI representative and MUST NOT be used to narrow, remove or adapt any test or reference behavior. Non-JSON ATen defaults for the optional keyword-only parameters are rendered as JSON null (meaning: no value supplied, so dtype/layout/device default to self and pin_memory defaults to False), which preserves the schema's None defaults without inventing values.
